knots.name: Uni knot

stages.name: Thread the tag through the eye
Lay the tag back to make a loop
Pull the tag: the coils close up
Pull the main line: knot slides to the eye

knots.source: Animated Knots (Uni Knot); Vic Dunaway's original uni knot instructions (six turns)
overUnder: Eye: standing line OVER the near rim, U-turn in the hole, tag back UNDER the near rim (line wraps the eye wire once).
Loop: tag runs back along the standing line, turns up OVER the standing line, arcs back towards the eye and comes down OVER both lines (closes the loop).
Each of 6 wraps: UNDER (behind) both lines going up, OVER (in front of) both lines coming down, always inside the loop, working away from the eye.
Tight: coils sit round standing line + tag + loop remnant; tag exits at the end away from the eye.

knots.name: Blood knot

stages.name: Tag A: wrap 1 round line B
Tag A: wrap 2 round line B
Tag A: wrap 3 round line B
Tag A: wrap 4 round line B
Tag A: wrap 5 round line B
Tag A back DOWN through the centre gap
Tag B: wrap 1 round line A
Tag B: wrap 2 round line A
Tag B: wrap 3 round line A
Tag B: wrap 4 round line A
Tag B: wrap 5 round line A
Tag B back UP through the same gap
Pull both main lines: wraps close up

knots.source: Animated Knots (Blood Knot: five to seven turns each side, tags through the centre gap in opposite directions)
overUnder: Tag A wraps line B 5 times going right: OVER B coming down, UNDER B going up.
Tag A returns above its wraps, goes OVER line A, DOWN through the centre gap, UNDER line B.
Tag B wraps line A 5 times going left, same twist direction: OVER A going up, UNDER A coming down.
Tag B returns below its wraps, goes UNDER line B, UP through the same gap, OVER line A. Tags exit in opposite directions.

knots.name: Palomar knot
knots.turns: overhand tied once with the doubled line

stages.name: Double the line, push the loop through the eye
Pass the loop over the hook

knots.source: Animated Knots (Palomar Knot): double the line, through the eye, overhand, loop over the hook, tighten, trim
overUnder: Doubled line through the eye: OVER the near rim, UNDER the far rim.
Overhand: the doubled line rises and goes round to make a ring above the line, and crosses OVER the incoming line.
The bight end goes UNDER the incoming line into the ring, up through the middle, and out OVER the top of the ring.
Loop over the hook: the bight surrounds the hook's bend and passes OVER the shank, so the hook goes through it.
Finished: the bight sits round the shank by the eye (front leg OVER the shank, back leg UNDER).

knots.name: Surgeon's loop
knots.turns: loop passed through the ring twice (double overhand)
knots.source: Animated Knots (Surgeon's Loop: a double overhand knot tied in a bight)
overUnder: The doubled line goes down and round to make a ring, and crosses OVER the incoming line.
Pass 1: the bight end goes UNDER the incoming line, down through the ring, out OVER the bottom of the ring.
It comes back up BEHIND the bottom of the ring, then pass 2 goes down through the same ring and out OVER the bottom.
Crossings alternate under/over all the way along (5 crossings: a double overhand).
